tools.purpose: Single-port trigger debug demo: one Tk GUI and one local TCP pass-through share a single serial or USB TMC session, drive the REFMEM unified control plane across all boards, run conventional single-board OTA with automatic receipts, and expose node-sequence application SCPI
tools.notes: GUI and TCP clients share one Dispatcher and therefore one transport session; no second port or second VISA session is opened. The REFMEM channel uses SYSTem:CTRL:EXECute with target/required masks and reads aggregate plus per-board ACK evidence. The application channel sends TRIGger/CONFigure SCPI to the coordinator. Conventional OTA uses BEGIN/PBEGIN+DATA+END and explicit BOOT/COMMIT, and writes an OTA receipt plus .sha256 sidecar automatically. TDMA stream OTA is read-only until the firmware path closes. Simulation mode implements the same surface for offline demos. Not yet bench-tested.
